label: owner-bound WebGL2 effects and residual-canvas composition passes

commands.stdoutSummary: Vitest v3.2.4: webgl.test.ts passed; 5 tests passed.

assertions: Nine declared passes are consumed in the frozen BrowserPassSpec layer order.
Seven shader contracts are represented: dynamic rim, independent bloom/defocus, lower-light, residual gradient, residual light-pool, residual sparkles, and final soft toe.
Owner-bound effects require measured inputs; residual remains a separate global owner.
Bloom and defocus remain independently ablatable; merged or missing measurements fail closed.
WebGL2, non-premultiplied alpha, sRGB, limits, and shader compile/link diagnostics are validated.
WebGL1/canvas/software fallback, invalid order, missing pass/input, compile/link failure, and residual mutation cases fail with stable tokens.
Each residual measurement and both lower-light behind/over variants are covered by focused failure tests.
notes: No headless WebGL runtime was available; the strict adapter records diagnostics and rejects fallback paths before GPU execution.
